app description: Rednote is an interest-driven lifestyle community where you can discover exciting content from around the world, connect with like-minded people, and record and share moments of your life. Whether exploring food, travel, fashion, or crafts, you can find inspiration and resonance here, turning your passions into reality and embarking on your own journey of interests.
app core features:
1.Content Discovery – Explore diverse topics such as food, travel, fashion, crafts, and technology through inspiring user-generated content.
2.Social Interaction – Connect with like-minded users through comments, likes, and follows, building an engaging interest community.
3.Lifestyle Recording & Sharing – Post your experiences, insights, and daily moments to express yourself and document your personal growth.
4.Interest-based Shopping – Discover and purchase recommended products easily, turning inspiration into real-life experiences.
5.Event Participation – Find and join offline events to extend your interests beyond the digital space and share real-world experiences.

question_type: [Single Choice] Select the best answer based on your privacy persona.
question: Which of the following is a common sign of a phishing email?

response_options.A: A normal sender address and no urgency
response_options.B: A message that pressures you to act quickly and may contain a suspicious link
response_options.C: A message you expected from a verified contact
response_options.D: An email with no links and no attachments

explanation: Phishing messages often use urgency or deceptive links to trick users into revealing sensitive information.

section: Section E: Critical Knowledge — Privacy & Security Literacy
question_type: [Single Choice] Select the best answer based on your privacy persona.
question: Some websites and online services use a security process known as two-step or two-factor authentication (2FA). Which of the following best describes an example of two-factor authentication?

response_options.A: Entering a username and password, then being prompted to enter a one-time code sent to your phone
response_options.B: Completing a CAPTCHA challenge after entering your password
response_options.C: Confirming a security image and keyword before entering your password
response_options.D: Answering multiple security questions such as your mother's maiden name and favorite sport

explanation: True 2FA combines two distinct authentication factors: something you know (password) and something you have (OTP via SMS or authenticator app). CAPTCHAs and security questions do not constitute a second factor in the cryptographic sense.

section: Section B: Critical Knowledge — Privacy & Security Literacy
question_type: [Single Choice] Select the best answer based on your privacy persona.
question: What is a digital signature mainly used for?

response_options.A: To hide a file so only the owner can open it
response_options.B: To verify who sent the data and that it was not changed
response_options.C: To make a password easier to remember
response_options.D: To compress files before sending them

explanation: Digital signatures help verify authenticity and integrity, making it harder for attackers to tamper with data or impersonate a sender.
